meta.title: Start, find, stop and restart stacks from the terminal: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: devhost start [names]
nodes.explanation: devhost start [names] finds the root manifest upward up to the first .git folder (or --manifest, MAN-01). The first line names the stack, its worktree label and size: 'Starting Acme Shop from main ~/acme · 6 services' (SEL-4, FB-10, WORD-11). Against a running stack, left-out names start into it with their dependencies: 'Started admin in Acme Shop · https://admin.shop.localhost/ · 1.2 s'; when all already run it prints only those URLs; during a stack-wide operation it refuses naming it and exits 1 (SEL-7, O6, CC-7, HOLD-3). With no manifest, the error names the .git repository-root search boundary (stack-run-stop-17), prints devhost init (O52: writes a starter devhost.toml from package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod or Procfile, refusing overwrite) and the Quickstart URL. devhost --help's Quickstart puts devhost init right after first-run-setup's Caddy steps (devhost caddy download, privileged-ports on Linux, start), and devhost skill prints offline embedded guidance naming devhost stack info / status, service, logs, reload, upgrade, restart and stack restart (O18, O52, O62). Resolves stack-run-stop-12, stack-run-stop-17 and stack-run-stop-01.

Replaces: skill source and subcommand help

nodes.label: Detached status line
nodes.explanation: devhost start --detach names the stack within a second, 'Starting Acme Shop in the background from main ~/acme · 6 services', then keeps one status line updated on a terminal, 'Starting Acme Shop · 3 of 6 running · waiting for api · health check 2 s of 30 s · 7 s', or prints one line per change when piped (FB-10, STATE-1, ACT-4, WORD-11). It ends with labelled local and preview URLs (marking offline remote previews on repeat starts, relay-previews-05), the ready line, 'All stacks on devbox: …' (O61), 'Log: devhost logs' and any idle timeout note (ACT-10). Ctrl-C cancels cleanly without an error tag (FAIL-5, KEY-14); failure before readiness stops started services via O30's unified parallel routine and names the cause once (FAIL-1, FAIL-3). devhost logs [-f] [service…] reads one per-manifest log kept across replacements, written by foreground and detached stacks alike with run headers, timestamps and ERR:/WARN: tags (FB-7, CC-21, CC-23). Resolves stack-run-stop-04, stack-run-stop-05 and agent-cli-journey-05's log slice.

sources.label: Replaces: Started line with unlabeled URLs
Replaces: a new log folder per replacement

nodes.label: Ready line and URLs
nodes.explanation: Each service's URL prints labelled as soon as its route answers, primary first; with [remote] configured, local hostnames stay active alongside public preview hostnames, both labelled (local and preview), missing DNS flagged, offline relay keeping local URLs running, and --local publishing nothing to the relay (relay-previews-02). One certified ready line prints once every started service passes health checks (or O28's 1 s process window) with no leftover answering: 'Ready in 4.2 s: https://shop.localhost/ · 6 of 6 running', then 'All stacks on devbox: https://devhost.localhost/' (O61), the active proxy listener line (O39), and 'Ctrl-C stops Acme Shop' (FB-5, FB-10, SURF-15, CC-22). A failed service leaves the rest running and prints devhost service restart api on its own line (FAIL-1, MENU-6). Left-out services are counted, long lists collapse, and tokens never wrap mid-URL with OSC 8 links (WORD-5, WORD-8). Resolves stack-run-stop-03 with journey-crash-to-fix-05, stack-run-stop-10, relay-previews-02, and start slices of stack-directory-06 and proxy-settings-04.

nodes.label: devhost service restart
nodes.explanation: devhost service start|stop|restart <service|group>… reach the running stack through its loopback control port, as the toolbar does: each sends an operationId, waits for health checks with a progress line and prints one outcome per target, 'Restarted api · 2.6 s', 'Started admin and mail (admin depends on mail) · 3.1 s', 'Stopped worker · it reads not started, stopped by you'; a lost response is read back from the operation record, never resent (SEL-7, MENU-1, MENU-6, REV-12, ACT-1, CC-11, CC-37). Another service's restart queues, 'worker queued behind Restart api'; during a stack-wide operation it refuses naming that operation and its progress, exit 1 (HOLD-3, HOLD-1, CC-8). An external service refuses: 'search runs outside devhost; devhost checks it but cannot restart it' (MENU-3, ACT-9). Targets are services or groups; devhost service restart --all is in-process Restart Stack's terminal form, whose help says 'Restart Stack in the browser' (CC-11, MENU-6; applied default of owner item q86), while stack restart, restart and upgrade replace supervisors (O18). devhost reload [--dry-run] [--stdin] applies or checks the manifest (CC-23). Resolves agent-cli-journey-03.

nodes.label: stack info / status
nodes.explanation: O62 extends shipped devhost stack info (GET /__devhost__/stack-info) with alias devhost status, one code path and output contract (FB-11, ACT-1, ACT-2, CC-23): stack, worktree label, mode, state, summary and snapshot time, never a PID (every stack shares the supervisor's; AGENT=1 and --json add the stack ID), per-service state/cause/since/URL/changed files/next command, rejected manifest, blocked repository, remote preview status (relay-previews-05), last operation, 'Log: devhost logs' and 'All stacks on devbox: …' (O61). Exits 0 when every started service runs, 3 naming each that does not, 1 on command failure; --json uses state IDs and ISO times; --wait waits on an operation. A stack whose control server does not answer shows its state 'last seen' with devhost stack restart, exit 1; an unanswering supervisor is named once with its PID (STATE-4, R7-100). stack find resolves folders as devhost stop does (CC-34); interactive list, find and info point to serve sessions (serve-command-04); piped/AGENT=1 list keeps <PID><TAB><manifest path>, the PID the supervisor's. Resolves agent-cli-journey-01, stack-run-stop-08, serve-command-04 and stack-directory-06's list slice.

nodes.label: Multi-stack set first
nodes.sublabel: asks only if a turn ends
nodes.explanation: devhost stop --worktrees, devhost restart and devhost upgrade print their set before acting: each stack's name, worktree label, foreground or detached, and the conversations it would close, never a PID, 'Acme Shop  fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav  foreground · Claude Code working: "Fix the nav"' (SEL-6, SEL-4, FB-4, O18, WORD-11). Only when the set would end an agent's turn that works or waits do they ask, on a terminal with CI unset: 'Stop 3 stacks and end Claude Code's working turn in fix-nav? [y/N]', where anything but y or yes stops nothing (REV-7, REV-4, O33). Without a terminal, or under AGENT=1, they refuse on one devhost: ERR: line telling the agent to ask the person, and exit 1 (REV-8, WORD-9). --yes acts without the question, and post-upgrade scripts pass it; --dry-run prints the set and exits 0 (CC-12). restart and upgrade list serve sessions, which restart with the stacks (O31, CC-36). Worktree classification uses git worktree list --porcelain so a deleted worktree is classified without running Git in it, and other repositories are untouched (REV-11). Resolves stack-run-stop-07, stack-run-stop-16 and chat-conversations-03's slice.

nodes.label: Check, launch, certify
nodes.explanation: Before any service runs, devhost checks the manifest and includes against the schema, every service's cwd before worktree lookup, requested names, every hostname (including reserved hostnames) and fixed-port claim, and leftovers of an earlier killed run (REV-11, ACT-11); any problem stops the start with nothing started. Under O44, route path values use prefix matching (path = '/api' routes /api and everything below it, keeping longest-prefix order and '/api/*' compatibility); path without host ('routes nothing without host') and watch on an external service (ACT-8) warn with file, line, column and key while starting, counted on the ready line and listed in stack info / status. When [remote] is configured, relay connection runs in parallel with service startup and fails fast in under 5 s on non-retryable auth, fingerprint or reverse-port refusals naming connector.log (relay-previews-04). Slow health checks print what the probe last saw and failures explain what to change (STATE-1, ACT-4, FAIL-3). Resolves journey-new-project-01, journey-new-project-03 and relay-previews-04.

sources.label: Replaces: exact path match with O44 prefix
Replaces: HTTP probe kept only as pass or fail

nodes.label: Parallel stop
nodes.explanation: One unified routine serves devhost stop, stop --worktrees, stop --session, stack restart, restart, upgrade, start --detach cleanup, Worktrees Stop Stack and serve sessions (O30, O41, CC-35). It records the stop reason before signalling (ACT-10, HOLD-2), takes one shared process snapshot at t = 0 (containment.rs), sends a single termination signal per managed foreground service (interrupted-operations-06), and runs foreground stops (10 s shared grace + verified SIGKILL + 5 s check + shared 2 s 100 ms port scan = 15 s bound) and daemon status→stop chains (O41 20 s shared per-daemon deadline, whole-group SIGKILL on timeout = 20.12 s bound) in parallel from t = 0: 25.64 s combined worst case fits inside O30's 30 s default stopTimeout (configurable 5s..10m via --timeout > DEVHOST_STOP_TIMEOUT > devhost.toml > config.toml > 30s; widens to max(stopTimeout, max_daemon_override + 10s) when a daemon overrides > 20 s unless CLI --timeout caps). Never SIGKILLs a stopping supervisor; second Ctrl-C or second devhost stop forces remaining trees and groups (KEY-14). Resolves interrupted-operations-03 and interrupted-operations-06.

sources.label: Replaces: sequential FG and daemon stops
Replaces: fixed 15 s grace, then gives up
Replaces: duplicate SIGTERM on shutdown

nodes.label: Restart or upgrade
nodes.explanation: One devhost supervisor runs every stack and serve session of a state directory (O18). devhost stack restart starts a new run of one stack inside it, moving to this executable only when no other stack shares it, otherwise warning once with the supervisor's PID that devhost restart switches it. devhost restart captures every run's launch, drains the old supervisor through the parallel stop routine up to stopTimeout, and starts every stack and serve session in one new supervisor running this executable; devhost upgrade swaps a user-writable binary (latest release, SHA256SUMS, managed-install guard) and then runs that step; a new binary alone only joins the old one. Each stack prints 'Restarted Acme Shop (main ~/acme) · 11 s', then once 'Every stack and serve session now runs in a new devhost 0.0.22 supervisor (PID 85502)'; the check compares stack ID and root manifest (REV-13). A removed folder stops its stack; an unopenable serve folder stays, reported. A replaced foreground terminal prints 'Replaced by devhost restart at 14:02. Acme Shop keeps running without this terminal.' and exits 0 (CC-24). Resolves stack-run-stop-13, stack-run-stop-02 and stack-run-stop-15.

sources.label: Extends: stack restart, restart, upgrade
Replaces: 15 s wait and per-restart log dirs

nodes.label: One line per operation
nodes.explanation: Every operation on the running stack, from any origin, prints one outcome line in its terminal and log, never the URL list again: 'Started admin · https://admin.shop.localhost/ · 1.2 s · from a page on shop.localhost' (FB-3, FB-7, FB-10, WORD-4, CC-22). Services devhost stops for an operation (Restart Stack, switch, hot reload, shutdown) are steps, never exits awaiting restart, and a switch names both worktrees by label (FAIL-5, ACT-3, SEL-4, WORD-11). An exit prints 'api exited with code 1 at 14:01' then devhost service restart api (MENU-6); an external signal names signal, status, time and sender (CC-24). A daemon stopping or recovering prints one line each. Proxy loss distinguishes devhost caddy stop from unexpected Caddy exit, plus recovery (ACT-10). Relay disconnects or dead connectors report within 15 s, relaunch dead connectors within 15 s, mark remote URLs offline across CLI queries, and log recovery duration (relay-previews-05). Config saves print 'All stacks on devbox: …' when the directory moves (O61). Resolves stack-scale-07, worktree-switch-04, interrupted-operations-04, manifest-hot-reload-2-02, notices-and-feedback-04, proxy-settings-04 and relay-previews-05.

sources.label: Replaces: every exit waits for a restart
Extends: relay drop detection and auto-relaunch

nodes.label: Stopped Acme Shop
nodes.explanation: The stop first names its target by name and worktree, never by the shared supervisor's PID: 'Stopping Acme Shop (main ~/acme) · 6 services · closes 1 conversation: "Fix the nav" (Claude Code, working)'; it acts on the one stack it resolved and never asks (SEL-6, FB-4, REV-7, WORD-11). Success is certified only once no process, route or port claim of the stack remains: 'Stopped Acme Shop · 6 services · 6.1 s · closed "Fix the nav" (Claude Code, was working)' (FB-5, ACT-11, WORD-4). Processes cannot be un-stopped, so there is no Undo: the outcome names the way back, 'Start it again in ~/acme with:' and devhost start on its own line (UNDO-5); closed conversations stay listed and resume after the next start (UNDO-4, O23). The stack's terminal ends with its reason line, and an open page's lost-connection notice reads 'Acme Shop stopped. Start it with devhost start in ~/acme' (ACT-10, HOLD-2). With no manifest stack running and serve sessions active, devhost stop names them with devhost stop --session <name> instead of failing silently (serve-command-04, STATE-2). Resolves chat-conversations-03's slice, stack-run-stop-06 and serve-command-04's stop slice.

sources.label: Replaces: process(es) and PID lines
Extends: serve session hint on no-manifest stop

nodes.label: Stopped-stack page
nodes.explanation: However a stack ends (devhost stop, Ctrl-C, idle timeout, stack restart / restart / upgrade, killed, every service exited), its terminal and log print one line with the reason and time: 'Acme Shop stopped at 02:14 after 30 min without requests (idleTimeout)' (ACT-10, CC-27). Under O15 and O63, strict configured-hosts-only TLS stays in place for arbitrary unknown HTTPS hostnames (zero on-demand certs), while each stopped stack keeps its configured Caddy routes and HTTPS certs active for 24 hours (or until another stack claims the hostname or Caddy stops) so revisiting https://shop.localhost/ renders this full page over HTTPS: 'Acme Shop stopped', that sentence, 'Start it again in ~/acme with', devhost start with Copy, and All Stacks on devbox (O61; directory lists stopped stacks whose run lasted >= 1 min). Uses shared status-page components without the toolbar, starts nothing (O10), fits all acceptance viewports and 320 px reflow (SURF-9, O8), Tab reaches Copy then All Stacks on devbox, and Copy keeps focus announcing 'Copied devhost start' once (KEY-11, FB-9). Resolves stack-run-stop-11.

sources.label: Keeps: strict TLS; adds 24 h stopped routes
Replaces: generic 404 naming no stack

nodes.label: Start refused in place
nodes.explanation: Every manifest problem prints at once, grouped by file relative to the root manifest, as file:line:column, key and message with the offending line and close key: 'admin/devhost.toml:3:1  services.admin.hostname  unknown setting; did you mean host?', then 'Nothing started. Fix the manifest and run devhost start again' (FAIL-2, MENU-4, WORD-7, WORD-8). Hostname (including reserved hostnames) or port clashes name the owning stack, its worktree and stop command; unknown names separate services from groups with closest match. A missing cwd prints 'devhost.toml:12:7  services.api.cwd  folder api does not exist in ~/newapp', never a Git error (REV-11). Missing manifest errors name the .git search boundary and devhost init (stack-run-stop-17, O52). Non-retryable relay auth, fingerprint or reverse-port refusals fail fast in under 5 s naming cause and connector.log (relay-previews-04). Under AGENT=1 every problem joins one 'devhost: ERR:' line (FB-11, WORD-9). Resolves stack-run-stop-09 with manifest-hot-reload-03, journey-new-project-04, stack-run-stop-17, relay-previews-04 and agent-cli-journey-05's ERR: slice.

nodes.label: Leftovers named, stopped
nodes.explanation: When the shared devhost supervisor died first (kill -9 or a crash), its record keeps each service's process group, cross-platform start identity (already shipped on Rust main in containment.rs, ACT-14, retiring process-containment-01 and process-containment-02), ports and hostnames, and the next command finds what still runs (ACT-11). devhost stack info / status and stack list say 'Acme Shop is not running, but 2 services of its killed run still do: api (PID 8812, port 4000), worker (PID 8820)'. devhost start refuses before launching a service whose port or hostname a leftover holds: 'api's port 4000 is held by a leftover of Acme Shop's killed run: bun run src/server.ts (PID 8812, started 13:02)', then devhost stop on its own line, so a leftover is never reported ready (REV-11, FAIL-3). devhost stop signals only processes whose start identity matches the record: 'Stopped 2 leftover services of Acme Shop's killed run: api and worker · 1.4 s' (FB-5). Resolves interrupted-operations-02; builds on containment.rs and the interrupted-operations-01 stopgap (related).

Replaces: stale stack records dropped silently

nodes.label: Each stack's own result
nodes.explanation: A stop that cannot certify its end within O30's stopTimeout (30 s default, configurable 5s..10m, widening for daemon overrides > 20 s) names each survivor with its service, PID and port, 'Acme Shop is not fully stopped: worker (PID 8820, port 4300) still runs', and exits 1 (FAIL-1, ACT-11). A multi-stack command attempts every member and ends with one line per stack, 'Stopped Acme Shop (main ~/acme) · 4.1 s', 'Acme Shop (Detached 3f9c2a1 ~/review/acme) is not fully stopped: worker (PID 8830, port 4310) still runs', and exits 1 naming each stack that still runs; one failure never ends the run (FAIL-1, SEL-4, WORD-11). A replacement whose shutdown outlasts stopTimeout is not left down without a word: 'Acme Shop was not restarted: worker (PID 8820) is still stopping after 30 s; nothing was started', then the command that starts it again, and exit 1 (FAIL-2, UNDO-5). A second devhost stop forces remaining service trees and daemon groups (KEY-14). Resolves stack-run-stop-14 and the outcome half of stack-run-stop-13.

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: devhost stop's 'process(es)', 'Sending SIGTERM' and 'stopped cleanly' lines; the shared supervisor's PID on per-stack lines; its fixed 15 s give-up with no list of what still runs; duplicate shutdown signals (interrupted-operations-06); the fixed 15 s of stack restart and restart; restart-<random>/<stack ID>.log folders; 'devhost is waiting for a restart'; generic 404 or TLS error for a stack stopped within 24 h (O15, O63); [remote] removing local hostnames and 45 s silent wait on bad relay credentials; '[ERROR] received SIGINT' for cancelled detached starts; 'stack ownership changed; refresh worktrees'; stop --worktrees ending at its first failure or on a missing folder; mid-token wrapping; reprinted URL lists

Merged: devhost stop, stop --worktrees, stop --session, stack restart, restart, upgrade, start --detach cleanup, Worktrees Stop Stack and serve sessions share one parallel stop routine, stopTimeout precedence, progress line and certified outcome (O30, O41); devhost stack info and short alias devhost status share one code path (O62); stack list, stack find and devhost stop share one resolver (SEL-6)

New: devhost upgrade, a swap followed by devhost restart's step (O18), devhost status alias for extended devhost stack info [--json] [--wait] (O62), devhost logs [-f] [--path], devhost reload [--dry-run] [--stdin], devhost service start|stop|restart <service|group>… and devhost service restart --all (CC-11), devhost init (O52), offline embedded devhost skill; --timeout, --dry-run, --yes and turn-ending question (O30, O33); stopTimeout and machineName in config.toml (O30, O61); ready line, additive local + preview URLs, 'All stacks on devbox: …', proxy line; active serve-session guidance (serve-command-04); 24 h stopped-stack HTTPS route, page and end line (O63); leftover detection; fail-fast and reconnect relay reporting; probe's last status

Changed: path uses O44 prefix routing; start <names> starts left-out services into a running stack (O6, CC-7); no-manifest errors name the .git boundary (stack-run-stop-17); stack find treats folders as folders (CC-34); stop runs FG + daemon in parallel from t = 0 with one signal inside 30 s default stopTimeout (O30, CC-35); help and output say stack restart restarts one stack inside the shared supervisor and restart every stack and serve session in a new one (O18, CC-31); replaced foreground stacks hand off and exit 0 (CC-24); an unopenable serve folder is reported (O31, CC-36); a restart keeps running services (SEL-7); log headers name the stack ID; foreground stacks write the per-manifest log (CC-21); Rust lifecycle tests update to match

Kept: manifest discovery upward to .git; validation and claims before any service runs; detached start readiness wait, reuse, lock and cleanup on failure; slow health-check waiting line; failed service leaves rest running; stop releases hostnames/ports/routes and signals only containment.rs-verified processes (ACT-14); shared Caddy keeps running with configured-hosts-only TLS for arbitrary unknown HTTPS hostnames (O63); --worktrees stays within one repo; two output contracts; devhost never opens a browser; idle shutdown as configured

cards.title: Contract changes
items: CC-35: parallel FG + daemon shutdown from t = 0 within 30 s default stopTimeout (5s..10m, precedence --timeout > DEVHOST_STOP_TIMEOUT > devhost.toml > config.toml > 30s; widens for daemon override > 20 s unless CLI --timeout caps), unified across all callers, never killing stopping supervisor, forcing on second Ctrl-C or second stop
CC-12: stop --worktrees, restart and upgrade print their set, ask only when a turn would end, refuse elsewhere unless --yes, and take --dry-run

CC-31 (with O18, WORD-11): adds devhost upgrade, keeps shipped devhost restart (every stack and serve session in a new supervisor) and devhost stack restart (one stack inside the shared supervisor), saying which, and moves working-copy docs to worktree
CC-36: restart and upgrade restart every stack and serve session (foreground included) in a new supervisor; an unopenable serve folder is reported

CC-24: a foreground stack replaced by stack restart, restart or upgrade says which command replaced it, that its new run continues without this terminal, and how to follow and stop it, and exits 0; exit lines name signal, time and sender
CC-21: every stack writes its per-manifest log, foreground included
CC-22: shutdown lines name slow and force-stopped services; ready line; one outcome line per operation; URLs printed once
CC-23 (with O62): extended devhost stack info + devhost status alias (exit 3), devhost reload and devhost logs; one ERR: line holding every issue
CC-11: devhost service start|stop|restart <service|group>… (services or groups only)
CC-7 (terminal half): selection changes while the stack runs via devhost service start/stop or devhost start <names>
CC-34: stack find resolves folders as devhost stop does
